jobs.facts: About Enode The grid was built for predictable, centralised power. | Enode provides the infrastructure layer that makes this possible. | The Home Energy team owns Enode's integrations and APIs for batteries, solar inverters, HVAC, and smart meters, along with the home energy management (HEM) system and statistics that customers build on. | Debug and ship production features in Node/TypeScript on our AWS-based stack. | Explore our API docs and the Enode Tech Blog to see what we ship and how we think about it. | Nice to have: Experience with TypeScript/Node, AWS services, PostgreSQL, TimescaleDB, or similar production tooling. | Prior exposure to API-first products or integration platforms. |
